items.title: SteamLite 26.11.6
items.text: Optimised animations, and smooth scrolling for the mouse wheel.
features: Tabs you can grab and drag, with the page following them
A Play, Stop and Cancel button that changes shape
Lighter animations while a game is running

items.title: SteamLite 26.11.7
items.text: A big update: a faster start, play stats, a new profile you can edit, a friends drawer, Discord presence, a Smart library filter, and a way back from the beta. The Christmas theme is inside, and it unlocks on December 1.
features: Your library appears at once, then updates from Steam
Play stats: time by week, month or all time, streaks and a calendar
A new Profile page you can edit, and a friends drawer
Discord Rich Presence with real numbers from your library
Smart library: only games, no other Steam apps
Close to the tray, pause while you play, and navigation sounds
A Filters menu in the Library, and a fixed installer

items.title: SteamLite 26.12
items.text: A theme unlock: the Christmas theme, in red and white with a red and white logo and falling snow, appears in Settings on December 1 and stays until January 1.
features: The Christmas theme, from December 1 to January 1
Snow you can turn off from the theme's three-dot menu

items.title: SteamLite 27.1 Beta, "Graphine"
items.text: Graphine is the nickname for 27.1: a lighter, faster SteamLite that uses less memory and less of your PC while a game is running.
items.note: If it is not ready on the 15th, the date will move and we will say so here.
